text.autoconfig.simpleenddragonfight.opt: Turns the whole module on or off (with SimpleBuilding also its switch Enable Simple End Dragon Fight). Default: on.
On: the dragon has 300 health per counted player; off: the Vanilla 200 per player. Default: on.
Most players that add a health bar; 0 = every player counts. Default: 0.
Creative players count as well (spectators never do). Default: off.
A player who leaves the island, dies or disconnects keeps counting this long before the dragon loses the bar. Default: 60.
Horizontal distance from the exit portal within which players count. Default: 160.
Flight speed and turn rate of the dragon in its flying phases. Default: 1.2.
Added to the speed for every further player. Default: 0.015.
End crystals heal in proportion to the larger health. Default: on.
From half health the dragon calls Dragonmites near the exit portal. Default: on.
Dragonmites per wave for one or two players. Default: 2.
One more mite per wave for every two further players. Default: 1.
At most 8 + players living Dragonmites, never more than this. Default: 16.
Portal ring, rising dragon, growl with a shock ring and sparks for every player who enters the fight. Default: on.
Length of one entry animation. Default: 60.
Most waiting entry animations; beyond that the oldest is dropped. Default: 16.
Shows the Dragonmite spawn egg in the creative tab. Default: off.
Every further dragon summoned with End crystals adds this share to health, damage and speed, for good (world-wide count). 0 = off. Default: 0.15 (+15 %).
Highest total flight speed once summonings add to it. Default: 2.0.
From the set dragon on, every fight participant gets one reward item once, placed around the End portal. Default: on.
Defeated dragons (world-wide) needed before the reward appears. Default: 4.
Item id of the reward. Default: simplemobs:ender_heart (nothing happens while that item is not installed).
Dragon of this fight number and later glows chorus violet on the client (the 4th fight on). 0 = off. Default: 4.
Soul-blue + chorus dragon from fight no.
Dragon of this fight number and later glows soul blue and chorus violet together, pulsing in turn (the Ender Gem fight, 10th on). 0 = off. Default: 10.
Defeated dragons (world-wide) needed before every participant also gets the jewel once. 0 = off. Default: 10.
Item id of the second reward. Default: simplemobs:ender_gem (Ender Gem; nothing happens while that item is not installed).
Highest damage factor of the dragon through summonings; health and speed keep rising up to the summoning cap. Default: 2.0.
From the 2nd defeated dragon on, a fight drops 500 + this value x (fight number - 1) XP in total (Vanilla gives 500; the 1st fight keeps the Vanilla 12000). 0 = Vanilla. Default: 250.
Highest total XP of one dragon fight from the 2nd on. Default: 5000 (reached at fight 19).
One more Dragonmite per wave for every n further summonings (still limited by the mite maximum). 0 = off. Default: 3.
message.simpleenddragonfight.reward: %s waits for you around the End portal.
jei.simpleenddragonfight.info.dragonmite: Dragonmites appear once the Ender Dragon is down to half health. A Dragonmite killed by a player may drop Dragon Chitin.
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.1.title: Simple End Dragon Fight
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.1: A harder Ender Dragon fight: it scales with the players, flies faster, can be summoned again, enters with an animation and brings dragonmites.
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.2.title: One health bar per player
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.2: Every player on the main End island adds one full dragon health bar: 300 health per player (300, 600, 900 ...), or the Vanilla 200 per player with "raiseBaseHealth" off.
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.3.title: Faster dragon
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.3: The dragon flies and turns 20 % faster, plus 1.5 % per further player, at most 35 %.
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.4.title: Harder with every summoning
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.4: Every further dragon summoned with End crystals is harder for good:
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.5.title: Harder with every summoning
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.5: +15 % health, damage and speed per summoning, at most x3. Multiplies with the player bars.
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.6.title: Entry animation
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.6: Every player who enters a running fight gets a 3-second greeting: portal ring, the dragon rises and scents the newcomer, a growl with a shock ring, then sparks rain down.
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.7.title: Dragonmites
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.7: From half health on, the dragon calls Dragonmites near the exit portal: a first wave at once, then one every 30 seconds.
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.8.title: Config
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.8: Server file config/simpleenddragonfight.json; with SimpleBuilding the module is also switched by "Enable Simple End Dragon Fight".
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.9.title: Commands
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.9: /simpleenddragonfight config shows and changes every option of config/simpleenddragonfight.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.10.title: Commands
simpleenddragonfight.guide.page.10: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once. Permission level 2.
